about_the_game:
DRAGON BALL Z: KAKAROT Season Pass and its additional stories provide fresh perspectives, thrilling battles, and memorable moments from the Dragon Ball Z universe. Whether you’re a seasoned warrior or a newcomer, the Season Pass content promises excitement, challenges, and nostalgia.

• A NEW POWER AWAKENS Part 1

In this original episode, players get to relive the iconic Battle of Gods saga. Join Goku and his friends as they face off against the mighty Beerus, the God of Destruction. Train hard, unlock new transformations, and prepare for an epic showdown that will test your strength and determination.
  • New forms: Goku (Super Saiyan God), Vegeta (Super Saiyan God)
  • New Skills: God Kamehameha, God Heat Flash

• A NEW POWER AWAKENS Part 2

The adventure continues with this 2nd original episode. Dive into the Resurrection ‘F’ saga, where Frieza returns with a vengeance. As Goku and his allies, you’ll confront the resurrected tyrant and his formidable army. Unleash your ultimate power and protect Earth from impending doom.
  • New forms: Goku (Super Saiyan God SS), Vegeta (Super Saiyan God SS)
  • New Skills: Ultimate Kamehameha, Ultimate Galick Gun

• TRUNKS - THE WARRIOR OF HOPE

This DLC allows you to dive into Future Trunks’ timeline, where he faces unimaginable challenges and battles to ensure humanity's survival. In this gripping narrative, you’ll experience the fierce fight of Trunks’ life in a world of despair. The story unfolds after Goku succumbs to a virus in his heart, and the planet is ravaged by the androids. The surviving warriors, Trunks and Gohan, take up the mantle to protect Earth.
  • New Playable Characters: Trunks, Gohan (Future)
  • New Skills: Change The Future, Heat Dome Attack

A NEW POWER AWAKENS Part 1 can be played without clearing the Main Story.
A NEW POWER AWAKENS Part 2 can only be played after clearing the Main Story and A NEW POWER AWAKENS Part 1.
TRUNKS - THE WARRIOR OF HOPE can be played without clearing the Main Story.
